authority: Adur District Council and Worthing Borough Council

document_host.note: Idox PublicAccess_Live DMS, the same store pattern as Mid Sussex and Horsham, reached from the Idox summary tab's 'externalDocuments' link. FileSystemId is DA here (DM = Mid Sussex, DH = Horsham).

committee_papers.note: Committee ids read from the committee list on 2026-09-26. Committee papers were retrieved from this host in use in September 2026 at 3 s spacing; no committee document was re-downloaded for this change.

reference_format.note: AWDM/NNNN/YY. The same prefix is used by both councils sharing this install.

endpoints.note: The RunThirdPartySearch page returns the document list as inline JSON rows; each row's Guid is then a ViewDocument download. FOLDER1_REF is the human reference with slashes.

quirks.summary: The externalDocuments variant — documents are not on the Idox portal but on a separate PublicAccess_Live DMS (the same store pattern as Mid Sussex and Horsham).
quirks.detail: A run that follows Recipe C's documents tab as written finds no file links here and reports no error, so the application looks like it has no documents. The source prose records the variant for this install but not the documents tab's exact response; at Mid Sussex and Horsham that tab answers HTTP 200 reading 'Permission Denied'.
quirks.workaround: GET applicationDetails.do?activeTab=externalDocuments&keyVal=<keyVal>, follow the single off-host link to the DMS, and use the endpoints recorded above.

quirks.summary: Some large documents time out with a 504 on the first request and need a long read timeout plus retry; a handful stayed unrecoverable across retries.
quirks.workaround: Use a long read timeout and retry once or twice, then report the files that never came down rather than delivering a silently short set.

quirks.summary: Deemed-discharge letters are filed under the document type 'Decision Notice'.
quirks.detail: A classifier keyed on document type reads a deemed-discharge letter as a formal decision on the application, and may take its date and wording as the decision's.
quirks.workaround: On a condition-discharge application, read the first page of any 'Decision Notice' to confirm whether it is a formal decision or a deemed-discharge letter.

quirks.summary: An advanced search by proposal text returned a genuine-looking 'No results found' page; the same search on a fresh session returned results.
quirks.workaround: Retry once on a fresh cookie jar and _csrf, and run a date-only control search, before recording that nothing matched.

pacing.note: Portal, document store and committee system all worked at 3 s spacing in use in September 2026.

shared_portal.note: One install and one joint planning service serve both councils. The source prose says to attribute by reference prefix rather than by portal, but also records that the single AWDM/NNNN/YY prefix covers both — so the prefix does not in fact discriminate between them, and no working attribution key is recorded.

source_notes: ONE PORTAL, TWO COUNCILS - Adur District and Worthing Borough share this install and a joint planning service; attribute by reference prefix, not by portal (AWDM/NNNN/YY covers both). DOCUMENTS: the externalDocuments variant, same PublicAccess_Live DMS as Mid Sussex and Horsham - RunThirdPartySearch?FileSystemId=DA&FOLDER1_REF=<REF> returns the document list as inline JSON rows, then Document/ViewDocument?id=<Guid> serves the file. FileSystemId is DA here (DM=Mid Sussex, DH=Horsham). Verified end to end 22 Aug 2026. Some large documents time out with a 504 on first request and need a long read timeout plus retry; a handful stayed unrecoverable across retries.

verification.note: Verified end to end: externalDocuments -> PublicAccess_Live DMS (FileSystemId DA) -> Document/ViewDocument served the file.
Landing-page survey 2026-09-16: HTTP 200; vendor confirmed by fingerprint (idox-public-access)
Search worked over 1-31 July 2026; documents tab had no file links.

Document store host confirmed: RunThirdPartySearch on docs.adur-worthing.gov.uk (FileSystemId=DA) returned 80 document rows for AWDM/1193/25. Committee system confirmed as Modern.gov on democracy.adur-worthing.gov.uk (Adur Planning Committee 139, Worthing Planning Committee 168). Pacing, the deemed-discharge filing and a false-empty advanced search recorded from use in September 2026 (issue #67). The 2026-09-16 empty documents tab is the external-DMS variant, not missing documents, so the generic 'documents-tab-empty' quirk is dropped.
